title: Game inspired by NoHesi - Claude Opus 5.5
author: OceanFluxYT
selftext: A highway traffic driving simulator I made to play with my friends in school but wanted to release it to anyone else so here is the link : [polyweave.org](http://polyweave.org)

comments.author: stretchpants
comments.body:
I really like this! Where did you get the car models from? I peeked at the JavaScript and found 20 vehicle files (Camry, Civic, Model 3, F-150, VW bus, etc) 

physics.js looks fairly serious

replies.author: OceanFluxYT
replies.body: For the main car I gave claude a pretty specific prompt along with an image ai wanted the car to look like and just tweaked it a bit, for the traffic I didn’t need it to be great or anything so I let claude do its thing and just tweaked some of the models when I felt it needed some work.

comments.author: Inevitable_Ranger745
comments.body: Have you thought about releasing on mobile? I’d pay $2-3 to cut up on the toilet 🤣

comments.author: Inevitable_Ranger745
comments.body: A couple notes from about 10 min of single-player mobile play testing: Gas peddle gets stuck sometimes which affects my ability to not rear end everyone🤣. “Streak ended” UI is obstructing the view of the road and traffic from that. A lot of fun though good job

replies.author: OceanFluxYT
replies.body: Alr Ill def fix that, it wasnt intended to be played on mobile but I did want to add support for it so I make a quick version, I can fix it up though.
